title: Grand Bangkok, Phuket and Krabi
alt: Lit up temples on the banks of the Chao Phraya river in Bangkok
transport: Private sedan transfers with boat crossings and one shared city tour

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: City first, then two beaches. Seven nights is the shortest stretch that makes this route feel unhurried.
expert.tip: Book the Bangkok to Phuket flight before midday so you still get an afternoon on Patong beach. The Krabi road transfer from Phuket takes about three hours with a stop, so eat before you leave.

summary: Eight days from Bangkok to the Andaman coast. A private city tour and a dinner cruise in the capital, three nights in Patong with a Phi Phi excursion and a Phuket city tour, then two nights in Ao Nang with the Krabi 4 Islands tour.
included: Included: 7 nights in 3 hotels with daily breakfast; full day private Bangkok city tour; Chao Phraya Princess dinner cruise with international buffet; Phi Phi islands excursion with lunch; half day Phuket city tour; Krabi 4 Islands long tail boat tour; 18 airport, intercity and sightseeing transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Bangkok to Phuket flight; visa charges; travel insurance; island and temple entry fees; meals other than those listed; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: Bangkok city tour and a river cruise

1: Arrival at Suvarnabhumi Airport and private sedan transfer to your hotel
Check in on Sukhumvit Soi 4 and keep the evening free
Optional: Chatuchak weekend market or the Amphawa floating market
2: Breakfast, then a private car and guide for the full day city tour
The Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit and Wat Maha Phruettharam
Evening private transfer to the ICONSIAM pier on the river
Chao Phraya Princess cruise with an international buffet on board
3: Breakfast, check out and private transfer to Don Mueang airport
Optional: flight from Bangkok to Phuket, booked separately and not included
Private transfer from Phuket airport to your Patong hotel
Optional: an evening on Patong beach or along Bangla Road
4: Breakfast, then private transfer down to the Phuket pier
Boat transfer out to the Phi Phi group for the whole day
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, with lunch
Return boat and private transfer to Patong in the evening
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Wat Chalong, Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint on the west coast
Back at the hotel by mid afternoon with the rest of the day free
6: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer by road to Krabi
Check in at Ao Nang, where the cliffs come down to the beach
Optional: an evening on Ao Nang beach or the Emerald Pool inland
7: Breakfast, then private transfer to the Ao Nang pier
Long tail boat transfer out to Koh Poda, Tup and Chicken island
Snorkel the shallows and see Phra Nang cave on the headland
Return boat and private transfer to your hotel in the afternoon
8: Breakfast and an easy check out
Private sedan transfer to Krabi airport for your trip home

stops.name: Bangkok
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · On Sukhumvit Soi 4, a minute from Nana Skytrain

program.name: Temples, gems and a dinner cruise
program.description: Two nights in the capital with a private full day city tour and a buffet dinner cruise down the Chao Phraya after dark.

activities.name: Full Day Bangkok City Tour
activities.description: A private car and guide for the day, taking in the Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit, Wat Maha Phruettharam and a gem gallery.

activities.name: Chao Phraya Princess Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Boarding at ICONSIAM pier for an international buffet, live music and lit up temples along the riverbanks.

activities.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.description: Thousands of stalls across a vast weekend market, best reached by Skytrain and best walked early before the heat.

activities.name: Amphawa Floating Market
activities.description: A canal market outside the city where boats cook seafood at the water. Liveliest in the late afternoon.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Club Bamboo in Patong, a short walk from the beach

program.name: Patong, Phi Phi and the old town
program.description: Three nights in Patong with a full day on the water at Phi Phi and a half day tour of Wat Chalong, the old town and Karon viewpoint.

activities.name: Phi Phi Islands Excursion
activities.description: A full day across the Phi Phi group with Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, and lunch on the tour.

activities.name: Phuket City Tour
activities.description: A half day run through Wat Chalong, the painted shophouse streets of Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint over the west coast.

activities.name: Evening on Patong Beach
activities.description: Walk the sand as the light goes, then browse the stalls and cafes a street back from the beach front.

activities.name: Bangla Road After Dark
activities.description: Patong's night strip, closed to traffic after dark and lined with bars, street food and live music.

stops.name: Krabi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Timber House in Ao Nang, close to the beach road

program.name: Ao Nang and the 4 Islands
program.description: Two nights under the Ao Nang cliffs with a long tail boat tour of Koh Poda, Tup island, Chicken island and Phra Nang cave.

activities.name: Krabi 4 Islands Tour
activities.description: A long tail boat day across Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island, with snorkelling stops and Phra Nang cave on the headland.

activities.name: Ao Nang Beach
activities.description: The main Krabi beach strip, with long tail boats pulled up on the sand and cliffs rising straight out of the sea.

activities.name: The Emerald Pool
activities.description: A spring fed pool in the Khao Phra Bang Khram forest inland from Krabi, clear green and warm all year.
